description: React component implementing a custom DevTools interface with tab management, viewport control, and interaction modes, including WebSocket communication with a backend.

classes.name: DevTools
classes.description: React functional component providing a custom developer tools UI with tab management, viewport interaction, and inspector integration.

methods.name: tabFavicon
methods.description: Generates a favicon letter based on the hostname of a URL.

methods.name: imgCoords
methods.description: Calculates image coordinates relative to the viewport for mouse events.

methods.name: sendMouseEvent
methods.description: Sends mouse events ('mousedown' or 'mouseup') to the channel with calculated coordinates.

methods.name: onScreenMouseDown
methods.description: Handles mouse down events on the viewport, toggling interaction mode or sending events.

methods.name: onScreenMouseUp
methods.description: Handles mouse up events on the viewport, sending the event if in interactive mode.

methods.name: onScreenMouseMove
methods.description: Handles mouse move events, throttling updates and sending movement data.

methods.name: onScreenWheel
methods.description: Handles wheel events for scrolling within the viewport.

methods.name: onScreenKeyDown
methods.description: Handles key down events, including escape to cancel locator picking.

methods.name: onScreenKeyUp
methods.description: Handles key up events for the viewport.

methods.name: onOmniboxKeyDown
methods.description: Handles Enter key in URL/search box to navigate.
